moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins tomorrow, Friday August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off tomorrow. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Opening Match Focus
angles.copy: Defending champions Arsenal start their campaign at home against Coventry City tomorrow night. Can they get off to a winning start?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Wales' largest independent music and arts festival, Green Man, is currently transforming the Brecon Beacons, running from August 20th to 23rd.

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is in full swing right now in the beautiful Brecon Beacons! Who's there enjoying the music and magic?

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: From diverse music to arts and comedy, Green Man is delivering those perfect summer festival vibes. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Live
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's award-winning We Out Here Festival, celebrating world-class music, wellness, and culture, is happening now in Dorset until August 23rd, but is officially sold out.

angles.name: Festival Energy
angles.copy: The sold-out We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of soul, hip hop, house, and jazz to Dorset this weekend. Wish you were there?

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Vision
angles.copy: Curated by BBC Radio 6's Gilles Peterson, We Out Here is all about those genre-defying sounds. What's your favourite track from an artist playing this year?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's London Residency Continues
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's highly anticipated 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's The O2 is ongoing, with multiple dates this week including tonight, August 20th.

angles.name: Tonight's Show
angles.copy: Ariana Grande lights up The O2 tonight as her 'Eternal Sunshine' residency continues! Who's heading to see the pop superstar?

angles.name: Tour Buzz
angles.copy: With multiple dates across August, Ariana Grande is making London her home. What's the one song you NEED to hear live?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: East London's All Points East festival kicks off tomorrow, August 21st, bringing a diverse lineup of artists to Victoria Park through to August 30th.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East returns to Victoria Park tomorrow! Who are you excited to see at this epic East London festival?

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: From indie to electronic and pop, All Points East always delivers a stellar lineup. What acts are on your must-see list this weekend?

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival Starts
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Beautiful Days Festival begins tomorrow, August 21st, at Escot Park in Ottery Saint Mary, Devon, running until August 23rd.

angles.name: Devon's Festival
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival kicks off tomorrow in Ottery Saint Mary! Get ready for a weekend of great music and good times in Devon.

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: More than just music, Beautiful Days offers a fantastic family atmosphere. Who's making the trip to Escot Park this weekend?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Week
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals are set to take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park next weekend, August 27th-30th, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, and Florence + The Machine.

angles.name: Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Reading & Leeds Festivals! Who are you most excited to see on the main stage?

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: With Charli XCX, Dave, and Florence + The Machine leading the charge, Reading & Leeds is going to be massive. What's your festival anthem?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaches
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of the summer season for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Just over a week until the Summer Bank Holiday! How are you planning to make the most of the long weekend?

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: The last bank holiday of summer is almost here. What's been your favourite summer memory of 2026?
